Cloud Infrastructure Intern
Northwind Cloud Services · Edmonton, AB · On-site

About the job

Northwind Cloud Services is hiring a Cloud Infrastructure Intern to support our platform
reliability team. You will work alongside our infrastructure engineers on monitoring,
automation, and incident response.

Responsibilities
• Support infrastructure automation using Terraform and Ansible
• Assist with monitoring and alerting configuration
• Participate in on-call shadowing and incident review

Qualifications
• Enrolled in a computer science, information technology, or systems program
• Familiarity with Linux and at least one scripting language

Term: Fall 2027 (8 months)
Pay rate: $28.50 per hour

Applications close 2027-06-18.
